_comment: Movement/dance videos for the 'Let's Get Moving!' slide (slide 2) and the 'Let's Move Again!' slide at the end - both use the same pick. One is chosen at random when intro_video_youtube_id is empty in content.json, which is the normal case (the AI writing the content has no internet access and is told not to invent an id).
_selection_rule: Real people and kids actually dancing hard - jumping, stomping, freeze-dance games. NOT cartoon/lyric-video songs where nothing moves, and NOT a single adult sitting and singing with a guitar. An energetic video that has nothing to do with the lesson topic beats a sluggish one that matches it.
_verified: 2026-08-11: every id below checked live - the video exists, the title/channel is what it says here, and playableInEmbed is true (a video with embedding disabled shows up as an error box inside PowerPoint). Re-check with the same two calls before adding any new one: https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<ID>&format=json for title/channel, and the watch page for "playableInEmbed":true.
